status: Complete - London and New York both narrated.
character: One-way pump in London with nothing to trade, then an 897-point collapse in the first 30 minutes of the New York cash session. One break-even and one win.

macro_read.prior_day: 'The previous day before market close it just pumped for the last hour - rallied up fucking 700 points in the last hour of New York.'
macro_read.verified: Correct. The prior cash session's final hour (16:00-17:00) ran +581pt net and +608.5pt low-to-close; from the 15:13 low to the close is +830.5pt, and the last three hours net exactly +706pt.
macro_read.attribution: 'Obviously there's some sort of political incentive behind New York PM being that volatile and just pumping up.' Later, on the open: 'Peak peak fucking Trump market manipulation here.'

decisions.narration: I didn't take any trades in London. I was actually looking for a rebalance since it pushed all day. Once I realised it was just straight going up there was no good entries anyways - no closure through 2 levels at once. Closed through the BB MA multiple times but no other opportunities. Was just straight pumping. It was trading along VWAP +2 - fucking mean to enter off there.

verification.was_it_one_way: YES. Price held above BOTH the 15m and 1h BB MA for 100% of the London window; the deepest approach to the 15m came within 1.09pt and never touched it.
verification.the_one: 03:03 3m UP through its own MA and the developing VAH - a long, three minutes into the open, in the direction he had already dismissed. The other two (04:48 3m, 04:50 2m, both DOWN) closed through VWAP+1 and VAH but NOT their own BB MA.
verification.verdict: Mechanically correct under his own grammar.

trigger.note: He also named POC. The developing POC stepped to 30,167.50 on that very minute and the candle closed at 30,171.50 - just ABOVE it, so on our profile it did not close through. Nearest miss of the corpus; possibly his profile differs by a few points.

entry.level: VWAP+1 (ours 30,172.23 - 30,172.45 across the next three minutes)
entry.dictated_as: 'Manchu was at 30,172.5' - garbled, the price is unambiguous

stop.rationale: Above the candle that displaced below - its high is 30,201.75, so 0.75pt of clearance.

management.action: Moved to break-even before the cash open.
management.quote: Moving to break even for market open - open volatility can cook you even if ur thesis is wrong.

what_happened_next.trader_reaction: Wow, it would've obliterated take profit on open, but that's straight gambling for me.

decisions.value: THE MOST INSTRUCTIVE ROW IN THE CORPUS. A disciplined de-risk immediately before a volatility event cost him a 2.45R planned trade that ran to 29R, and he does not flinch. The rule is the rule; the outcome is not the teacher.

decisions.context: After an 897-point collapse in the first 30 minutes (high 30,193.00 at 09:30, low 29,295.75 at 09:59) price had traded down near VWAP-3. 'We're clearly bearish' - so this is a counter-trend rebalance long, not a reversal trade.

entry.level: VWAP-1 - 'that's obviously the closest structural level'
entry.note: Exact fill not stated. VWAP-1 sat at 29,578-29,580; his '180 points' to a 29,774 exit implies ~29,594.

stop.basis: He reports 'almost got stopped out by like two points'. The lowest low after the fill is 29,524.00 at 10:24, which puts the stop around 29,522. INFERRED, not stated - and it is NOT the displacement candle's low (29,488.00), which was never approached within 36pt.

targets.label: value area low
targets.IMPORTANT: This is the ANCHORED WEEKLY value area low, NOT the daily one. Daily VAL at 10:52 was 29,609.50 and had already been crossed by 10:26. Our anchored_weekly_profile gives awVAL 29,778 at 10:18 and 29,768 at 10:52 - his exit at ~29,774 sits between them.

decisions.target_sizing_rule: 'It's not going for a big target or anything, because we're clearly bearish, more so just looking for a rebalance.' A counter-trend rebalance gets a modest target by design.

declared_rules.quote: Obviously we're not trading before high-impact news. That is stupid.
declared_rules.note: A hard constraint, and the first concrete job for the macro/events agent (C3). It gates entries; it is not a general licence to sit out.

declared_rules.rule: MOVE TO BREAK-EVEN BEFORE THE CASH OPEN when carrying a pre-market position.
declared_rules.quote: Moving to break even for market open - open volatility can cook you even if ur thesis is wrong.
declared_rules.evidence: Applied on this day at a cost of ~29R of foregone move, and endorsed after the fact: 'that's straight gambling for me.'

declared_rules.rule: Target size scales to whether the trade is with or against the prevailing move. A counter-trend rebalance gets a modest target.
declared_rules.quote: It's not going for a big target or anything, because we're clearly bearish, more so just looking for a rebalance.

structural_finding.rule: THE CANDLE'S OWN BB MA IS A MANDATORY LEG OF THE PAIR.
structural_finding.evidence: Now 11 of 11 takes across four narrated days close through the candle's own BB MA. The second leg varies freely - VWAP band, developing POC, VAH, VAL - the own MA never does.
structural_finding.discriminating_power: On 2026-06-24 London it is the difference between 3 qualifying candles and 1, and it is what makes his 'no closure through 2 levels' account exact.
structural_finding.caveat: Still INFERRED from behaviour, not stated by him. Needs putting to him directly.

anchored_weekly_profile_CONFIRMED.observation: His AM target, described as 'the value area low', was taken at ~29,774. Our anchored_weekly_profile gives awVAL 29,778 (10:18) and 29,768 (10:52).
anchored_weekly_profile_CONFIRMED.significance: Second independent confirmation of the weekly profile, and the first on the VAL edge. Combined with the anchor rule he gave on 2026-06-23, the construct now looks right. The earlier +43pt VAH residual may partly reflect that he places take-profit a few points INSIDE the level rather than at it - not established, but it is the obvious candidate.
anchored_weekly_profile_CONFIRMED.operational: Where he says 'value area', check BOTH the developing daily profile and the anchored weekly one. On this day the daily VAL would have exited at ~30-45pt instead of 180.

trader_closing_note.quote: Some days the price action is not good. You're not taking as many trades when you know how to trade. Every day is a winning day. Just build a bot that wins every day.
trader_closing_note.reading: The first two sentences are the operative content and they match the evidence: the London pass and the pre-market break-even are both correct process. The last sentence is a joke and is not treated as a specification.
